summary: The old harness cannot select the supported entity-preserving ordinary-text mode.

assessment.necessity_reason: XMLDocument supports processEntities=false, which makes ordinary text retain recognized entities. The harness always uses the true default. XML input cannot change that constructor setting.

before.requirement: Parse ordinary XML text containing & with processEntities=false, retaining & in the text value.
before.reason: The harness constructs XMLDocument without arguments, so every input uses processEntities=true.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Ordinary text parsing selects the leave-entities mode when the document setting is false.
The leave-entities mode omits the entity-processing flag.
The selected change concerns cleanup of parsed nodes.

after.requirement: Parse ordinary XML text containing & with processEntities=false, retaining & in the text value.
after.reason: The mode remains supported, while the same harness still constructs the document with the true default.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Ordinary text parsing still selects the leave-entities mode when the document setting is false.
The leave-entities mode still omits the entity-processing flag.
The changed destructor cleans up parsed nodes.

assessment.comparison_reason: Both versions support the same constructor setting. The same default-only construction blocks it on both sides.
